checks.name: venue health, geo-blocked offshore venues reported as rows
checks.sql: SELECT venue, status, instrument_count FROM perps.main.venues() ORDER BY venue

checks.name: BTC contract sizes and ticks normalized per BTC
checks.sql: SELECT venue, symbol, contract_size, tick_size, funding_interval_hours FROM perps.main.instruments(underlying := 'BTC') ORDER BY venue, symbol

checks.name: Kalshi funding: native sign, x1095 annualization, per-contract mark rescaled (t = epoch seconds UTC)
checks.sql: SELECT epoch(funding_time)::BIGINT AS t, round(rate_per_interval, 10) AS rate, round(rate_annualized, 8) AS apr, mark_price FROM perps.main.funding(venue := 'kalshi', underlying := 'BTC', start_date := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-10 00:00:00+00', end_date := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-12 23:59:59+00') WHERE funding_time >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-12 00:00:00+00' ORDER BY funding_time

checks.name: Bitnomial ticks to USD and premium
checks.sql: SELECT mark_price, index_price, round(premium_bps, 6) AS bps FROM perps.main.funding(venue := 'bitnomial', underlying := 'BTC', start_date := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-12 00:00:00+00', end_date := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-12 23:59:59+00') WHERE symbol = 'PBTCUCZ50' ORDER BY funding_time DESC LIMIT 1

checks.name: cross-venue marks skip failing venues
checks.sql: SELECT venue, symbol, mark_price, mark_source FROM perps.main.marks(underlying := 'BTC') ORDER BY venue, symbol

checks.name: funding carry spread pairs
checks.sql: SELECT venue_a, symbol_a, venue_b, round(spread_bps, 4) AS bps, carry_trade FROM perps.main.funding_spread('BTC', start_date := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-10 00:00:00+00', end_date := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-12 23:59:59+00') WHERE symbol_a = 'PBTCUCZ50' ORDER BY venue_b

checks.name: order book normalized and cumulated
checks.sql: SELECT side, level, price, size_contracts, round(cum_usd, 4) AS cum FROM perps.main.order_book('kalshi', 'KXBTCPERP', depth := 5) WHERE level <= 2 ORDER BY side, level

checks.name: cursor pagination: three pages, terminates on an empty page
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, round(sum(size_usd), 4) AS usd FROM perps.main.trades('kalshi', 'KXBTCPERP', start_date := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-01 00:00:00+00', end_date := TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-01 00:10:00+00')

checks.name: liquidation estimate (Hyperliquid documented maintenance margin)
checks.sql: SELECT side, round(liquidation_price, 4) AS liq, maintenance_margin_rate, estimate_method FROM perps.main.liquidation_estimate('hyperliquid', 'BTC') WHERE leverage = 20 ORDER BY side

checks.name: static capability matrix
checks.sql: SELECT venue FROM perps.main.capabilities() WHERE capability = 'order_book' AND support = 'supported' ORDER BY venue
